test_bin_contains: test the bin.contains method checks if binary data contains a given pattern
test_bin_starts_ends_with: test the bin.starts_with and bin.ends_with methods match binary prefixes and suffixes
test_bin_encode_decode: test the bin.encode and bin.decode methods convert binary data to base64 and hex formats
test_bin_reinterpret: test the bin.reinterpret method converts binary data to numeric, temporal, or array types
test_bin_size: test the bin.size method returns the byte size of binary data in configurable units
